description: This file defines a Java interface named ErrorResponse, which models error responses associated with commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies methods for setting headers, retrieving exceptions, and indicates that its response type is always ERROR.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing error responses for commands, encapsulating methods to set headers, retrieve runtime exceptions, and defining that the response type is ERROR.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the error response.

methods.name: getDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Retrieves the wrapped DittoRuntimeException associated with this error response.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Returns the response type, always ERROR for this interface.
